intro: Welcome to Birgi, a historic town in İzmir province, whose story spans the 14th–19th century. This was the capital of the Aydınid emirate. Its great mosque, its madrasas and the Çakırağa mansion show the passage from emirate to empire in a single fabric.
history: In the fourteenth century, the town was the capital of the Aydınid emirate. Its great mosque, madrasas and tombs stand in the same fabric as the Ottoman mansions of later centuries. And the wall paintings of the Çakırağa mansion are among the richest examples of eighteenth-century Ottoman domestic decoration.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the great mosque, the Çakırağa mansion, the tomb of Mehmed Bey and the street fabric itself.
facts: Did you know? Marble blocks and inscriptions carried from the nearby ancient city of Hypaipa were built into the walls of the great mosque. And in the fourteenth century, this town was the capital of the Aydınid emirate.
outro: This brings our tour of Birgi to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Thank you for listening, and enjoy your visit.
